title: Your bug video, fixed and built
thisBuild: Stutter holds one speed, locked to the beat. The vial has four zones, bottom up: quarter, eighth, 16th and 32nd notes (it shows on the vial while held).
Settings is two short groups, Look and Playing, with a switch per on/off. Hold to record is gone: tap to start, tap to stop.
The loop strip is tighter: smaller loops, one bar of keys, a small Loop/Song switch. It closes when you change page or tap the page under it.
Click and Count-in sit in the top bar on every page (your fold's wide screen), and in Tempo.
Tempo drops down under the top bar instead of taking the whole screen.
Synth: To pad and Over moved up beside Scratch and the preset, so that row is gone.
Edit tray: no empty space at the top, shorter drawer keys, shorter FX vials. Repeat and Toss are smaller.
New: Auto trim (Settings, on), Auto sample (pad menu or Edit, Sound: the next sound lands on that pad), Chop to pads in the Sample sheet's Play tab, and a Mixer in Seq.
Icons: A to H as block letters and a bed for Rest in the song painter, and DROP in big letters on a grey key. FX tray's More is now Sample sheet.
watch: Hold the Stutter vial low, then high: does each height keep one steady speed?
Seq, then Mixer: move a pad's fader and the bank fader. Do levels stick and sound right?
Auto sample a pad, then clap once. Does it land and stop by itself?
Open the loop strip and tap a pad: it should close and the pad should still play.
limits: Mixer levels are per sound: two pads with the same sound move together.
Auto sample stops after a third of a second of quiet, so a long reverb tail gets cut short.
